name: Takamura Riria
source: A young woman of talent and beauty, whose flashy performances stand out even among the rhythmic gymnastics club. Because she is the granddaughter of the academy’s chief director, her behavior at school is immediately passed along to her family. So no one makes any advances on her. A cheerful and friendly girl, she has gotten used to this sort of environment. She is strong-willed and does not back down when the situation calls for it.
